_howto: Copy this file (e.g. scripts/evals/my_dataset.json) and fill it in for YOUR PDF. Run: python scripts/eval_e2e.py --dataset scripts/evals/my_dataset.json --email you@example.com --password YourPassword --corpus path/to/pdf-dir --profile grounded. Compare with --profile baseline. expected_pages: the page(s) where the answer lives. expected_keywords: words that MUST appear in a good answer (numbers and distinctive nouns work best). Unanswerable questions: answerable=false, empty keywords/pages.
